description: Karnataka announced plans for India’s first government-driven AI University and a new AI Hub at Google I/O Connect India 2026. The move is aimed at expanding research, startup support and AI use across public services.
body_lead: Karnataka to set up India's first government-driven AI university Karnataka has announced plans to establish India's first government-driven Artificial Intelligence University and an AI Hub to strengthen research, innovation and industry partnerships. The state also outlined a wider vision to integrate AI across governance, education, healthcare and agriculture.
